changeling.summary: Fey-touched shapeshifters who can wear any face and often keep several personas.

traits.name: Changeling Instincts
traits.summary: Proficiency in two of Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Performance and Persuasion.

traits.name: Shape-Shifter
traits.summary: Action: reshape your looks and voice (coloration, hair, sex, height, weight, Medium or Small size, even another species) with no change to your statistics; you can't copy someone you've never seen or change your limb layout, and gear stays as is. Advantage on CHA checks while shifted; an action returns you to your true form.

kalashtar.summary: Humans bound to renegade dream spirits, with steady minds and a touch of telepathy.

traits.name: Dual Mind
traits.summary: Advantage on WIS and CHA saving throws.

traits.name: Mind Link
traits.summary: Telepathy out to 10 ft per level. Magic action while speaking to a creature this way: it can answer you telepathically for 1 hour, or until another Magic action ends it.

traits.name: Severed from Dreams
traits.summary: The Dream spell can't target you. Each Long Rest, gain proficiency in a skill of your choice until your next Long Rest.

khoravar.summary: People of mixed human and elf descent who see themselves as a bridge between cultures.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.summary: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed.

traits.name: Fey Gift
traits.summary: Know Friends; after each Long Rest you may swap it for another Cleric, Druid or Wizard cantrip. Cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the species).

traits.name: Lethargy Resilience
traits.summary: Turn a failed save against falling or staying Unconscious into a success; then unusable until you finish 1d4 Long Rests.

traits.name: Skill Versatility
traits.summary: Proficiency in one skill or tool of your choice, which you may swap for another after each Long Rest.

choices.label: Skill or tool (swap after a Long Rest)
choices.note: a tool proficiency is also allowed

shifter.summary: Descendants of lycanthropes who can briefly let their bestial side surge forth.

traits.name: Bestial Instincts
traits.summary: Proficiency in one of Acrobatics, Athletics, Intimidation or Survival.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in darkness out to 60 ft.

traits.name: Shifting
traits.summary: Bonus Action: turn more bestial for 1 minute (end it as a Bonus Action) and gain Temp HP equal to 2 × PB. PB times per Long Rest. Each shift also grants the benefit of the option picked with the species.

options.name: Beasthide
options.summary: +1d6 extra Temp HP when you shift, and +1 AC while shifted.

options.name: Longtooth
options.summary: On shifting, and by Bonus Action on later turns of the shift, bite with an Unarmed Strike that can deal 1d6 + STR Piercing damage.

options.name: Swiftstride
options.summary: +10 ft Speed while shifted; Reaction when a creature finishes its turn 5 ft or closer to you: move up to 10 ft without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

options.name: Wildhunt
options.summary: While shifted, Advantage on WIS checks, and no creature within 30 ft gains Advantage on attacks against you unless you are Incapacitated.

warforged.summary: Living constructs of wood and metal built for the Last War, who feel pain and emotion.

traits.name: Construct Resilience
traits.summary: Resistance to Poison damage, and Advantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned.

traits.name: Integrated Protection
traits.summary: +1 AC, and armor you wear can't be taken off you against your will while you live.

traits.name: Sentry’s Rest
traits.summary: No need to sleep, and magic can't make you sleep. A Long Rest takes 6 hours spent motionless but aware.

traits.name: Specialized Design
traits.summary: Proficiency in one skill and one tool of your choice.

traits.name: Tireless
traits.summary: No Exhaustion from going without water, food or air.
